record.title: Validate one exact mapped store and the next-access stop
record.intent: Add the witnessed stock write as a bounded synthetic transaction without inventing device side effects.
requirements: Preserve the existing two read responses and group-wide continuous observation.
Add a mode allowing exactly one main-thread 32-bit store at the witnessed offset 0x3000 and value 0x05630000, bound to its instruction PC and opcode.
Record the accepted write in an observer-side ledger; advance PC by four with every other register unchanged and keep the mapping inaccessible.
Private positive controls must stop without response at a subsequent main-thread store and a worker mapped access.
Private negative controls must reject a changed write value and changed offset without completing a store.
Re-run the five existing controls with the rebuilt native executable.
Quiesce and account for all traced threads and exact cleanup; unknown accesses and bounds remain explicit negatives.
acceptance: Independent verification establishes two read responses, at most one modeled store, exact register preservation and terminal thread/state evidence.
No new read values or modeled device side effects; preserve enforcement and system_server and push the result before stock execution.
